title: MIMI extension points (mimi-protocol #190): structured refusal reasons, retry hints, request extensions, skippable GroupInfoOption
description: From the IETF 127 table and mimi-protocol #190 (Rohan: which messages need extension points). Haven (runne, comment 6898532669) and Mark (comment 6900044959, 2026-11-15) agree on: a structured refusal reason in UpdateRoomResponse instead of English errorDescription (covers #206), a per-ClientKeyMaterial retry hint for an exhausted client (#184, PR #201 only covers the code), extension dictionaries in UpdateRequest and KeyMaterialRequest, and every addition skippable by a receiver that doesn't know it (#195, PR #203). Children: spec work (draft PRs, posting needs Mark's OK) and mimid implementation (INVENTED codepoints marked until the WG assigns them).
